description: This file defines extension methods for configuring Azure Cosmos DB as a grain storage provider within the Orleans silo builder. It provides various overloads to add the Cosmos grain storage with options for custom partition key providers, default or named storage, and configuration via options or types. The code primarily interacts with dependency injection, configuring services, and managing provider options.

methods.name: AddCosmosGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Cosmos DB storage as the default grain storage with optional custom partition key provider and options configuration.

methods.name: AddCosmosGrainStorage
methods.description: Adds Azure Cosmos DB grain storage with specified name, custom options, and optional custom partition key provider type.

methods.name: AddCosmosGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures default Cosmos grain storage with options builder configuration.

methods.name: AddCosmosGrainStorage
methods.description: Adds Cosmos grain storage with specified name and options builder configuration.
